b: It features guest appearances from DJ Haram and $ilkmoney
Armand Hammer, the duo of billy woods and ELUCID, have released a surprise new album, Snakes & Ladders.

Featuring 16 tracks, it follows on from last year's Mercy LP, and features guest appearances from DJ Haram and $ilkmoney. There is also production from clipping., and frequent collaborators such as Kenny Segal, Preservation, Child Actor and Sebb Bash.

The album was written and recorded by Armand Hammer and their collaborators in the winter of 2025 into 2026. Its release comes as the duo round off their tour of North America this week, with the final show scheduled for Sunday (15 November) at New York's Music Hall of Williamsburg.
